Extract all images from a document into metadata

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle options_handle = htm_conversion_options_from_json("{\"extract_metadata\":true}");
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<html><head><title>Gallery</title></head><body><img src=\"https://example.com/photo1.jpg\" alt=\"Photo 1\"><img src=\"https://example.com/photo2.png\" alt=\"Photo 2\"><img src=\"/local/image.webp\" alt=\"Local image\"></body></html>", options_handle);
    htm_conversion_options_free(options_handle);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
